t: What Wind Turbine Reliability Database Is All About
title: What Wind Turbine Reliability Database Is All About
description: Wind turbine reliability is gearbox vs direct-drive, blades vs lightning: gearboxes historically failed most (costly crane replacements); direct-drive avoids the gearbox; blade leading-edge erosion steals 1-3% output yearly. Availability targets 97%+; O&M runs $40-50/kW-year onshore. SCADA data predicts failures — vibration, temperature, oil debris — before the crane is needed. This database is the complete turbine reliability record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
